subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo & stakeholder availability
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@finservco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo & stakeholder availability

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn more about FinServCo's throughput and reliability requirements for risk scoring and rules automation. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: low-latency inference for realtime scoring at ~10k reqs/day, 100ms p95 target
- Data sensitivity: PII in inputs; will need VPC + KMS integration for production
- Success metrics: 40% token cost reduction vs current baseline; stable p95 latency under load

Per our conversation, next best step is a short 30-minute product demo / technical intro where Marissa (solutions engineer) can walk through latency/cost controls, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and a brief walkthrough of observability and rollout controls.

Who I suggest include from your side: the technical lead for ML infra (CTO or Head of ML) and the security/compliance owner for a quick KMS/VPC note. If you can confirm 2-3 stakeholders, we’ll tailor the demo accordingly.

Proposed next steps / availability: can you confirm which of the following 30-minute slots works for you and the stakeholders? I can send a calendar invite once you pick one.

- Tue Apr 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed Apr 7, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu Apr 8, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If none of those work, reply with preferred windows and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a one-pager and suggested demo agenda for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129

Attachments:
- redwood-product-onepager.pdf
- redwood-demo-agenda.docx

From: Priya Shah <priya@finservco.com>

Cc: Anil Mehta <anil.mehta@finservco.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@finservco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo & stakeholder availability

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the materials — very helpful. Confirming the stakeholders we'd like to join:
- Anil Mehta (CTO) — technical lead for infra/ops
- Sara Gomez (Head of ML) — will want to see latency and model compatibility details

Availability from our side for a 30-min intro:
- Tue Apr 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — works for Anil and Sara
- Wed Apr 7, 2:00–2:30 PM PT — backup option if needed

Agenda request: can you include 10 minutes of technical deep dive on model routing/batching and 5 minutes on security/KMS integration? That will help us prepare the right folks.

Also, can you include an estimate of token/unit pricing for a small pilot (50k tokens/month) in the follow-up? Not necessary for the demo but helpful for procurement prep.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director of Product, FinServCo
priya@finservco.com

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Priya.

I’ve booked Tue Apr 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PT and sent a calendar invite to Anil and Sara. Marissa will lead the demo and cover model routing/batching and the security integration window; I’ll handle the brief intro and next-step checklist.

Quick notes:
- Agenda (30 min): 5m intro + 10m latency/batching demo (Marissa) + 5m security/KMS discussion (Laura) + 10m Q&A / next steps
- Pricing: I’ll include a 50k-token/month pilot estimate in the invite and follow up with a short pricing sheet before the call.
- Prep: if your team can share a high-level request volume profile (example payload size and p95 latency target) that would help Marissa tailor the demo. You can drop it in the Drive link below or reply to this thread.

Calendar invite: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-product-demo
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/FinServCo/discovery-notes

Looking forward — see you on Apr 6.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129
